claims.claim: Dubai Metro's Red Line reopened on Monday after maintenance work.
claims.label: contradicted
claims.explanation: The claim is contradicted because the RTA confirmed the Red Line resumed full service on Monday after maintenance, which supports the claim rather than contradicting it [1]. Additionally, passengers returned to the Red Line on Monday morning with normal train operations, further supporting the claim [2].

claims.claim: All schools in Abu Dhabi will close for a month because of heavy rain.
claims.label: contradicted
claims.explanation: Abu Dhabi's education authority confirmed schools will only switch to remote learning for one day due to rain, not for a month [1]. Classes are expected to return to normal by Wednesday, contradicting the claim of a one-month closure [2].

claims.label: contradicted
claims.explanation: The RTA confirmed that the Red Line and the Green Line are operating normally today despite the rain [1]. Dubai Metro services ran on schedule on Tuesday, the RTA said [2].
